question: A 36-year-old man with no history of interest who, after high-energy trauma when falling from a motorcycle, presented a fractured mid-shaft tibial fracture, open, grade II Gustilo. Which of the following maneuvers or therapies is more effective for the prevention of infection?

options.opa: Immediate broad spectrum intravenous antibiotic therapy.
options.opb: Comprehensive debridement-washing of the wound in the operating room with at least 10 liters of physiological saline.
options.opc: Urgent stabilization of the fracture by external fixation and early closure of the wound.
options.opd: Early wound closure with antiseptics and oxygen therapy at two liters per minute.
